# rexxos-mu contract v0.3 for the playground MUs (cats1, cats2)
# Architecture: Tom Dyer.  Draft: Claude (Opus 5.5), 23 Nov 2026; v0.3 24 Nov 2026, for Tom's review.
# Every allow line carries its witness after "|". Anything not allowed here is a finding.
# Tom, 24 Nov: "if you can't justify them then they ought not be there".

allow process systemd systemd-journal systemd-udevd agetty | init and the serial console until the static init (stage D)
allow process systemd-logind dbus-daemon | only for ssh login sessions (pam_systemd), so only until M8; dbus is here because logind needs the system bus, nothing else on the MU uses it (cats1: only dbus-user-session and libdbus-1-3 depend on dbus, both optional)
allow process systemd-network | DHCP on eth0, which Azure requires
allow process chronyd | time: log ordering, key validity, policy time windows
allow process sshd bash (sd-pam) | bring-up channel, until M8
allow process rexx rxapi | mu-agent and mu_audit
allow process qemu-system-x86_64 firecracker mu-agent xtpd | MU duties
allow listen tcp 22 | bring-up channel, until M8
allow listen udp 68 | DHCP client
allow login root | locked; console break-glass
allow login azureuser | bring-up channel, until M8
allow unit ssh.service | bring-up channel, until M8
allow unit chrony.service | time
allow unit systemd-networkd.service systemd-networkd.socket systemd-networkd-wait-online.service | DHCP on eth0
allow unit apparmor.service | SecOp's MU profile set (to be written)
allow unit fstrim.timer | discard on the data disk
allow unit getty@.service | template only: serial-getty on ttyS0 is the break-glass console
allow package gcc-12-base | runtime base of libgcc-s1 and libstdc++6, which ooRexx needs

forbid package workload nginx* apache2* php* nodejs* postgresql* mysql* mariadb* redis* mongodb*
forbid package platform slapd* rabbitmq* kafka*
forbid package build gcc* g++* make cmake* python3-pip* cargo* golang* binutils* linux-headers* linux-azure-6.8-headers*
forbid package container docker* containerd* podman* runc* lxd* lxd-agent-loader
forbid package packaging snapd flatpak* | cats1, 24 Nov: /root/snap/lxd was left behind by a snap install of lxd
forbid package toolkit curl wget tnftp ftp telnet netcat-openbsd git perl python3 tcpdump strace vim vim-tiny rsync

# v0.3: the programs on the MU.  A program needs a witness, by name or by its package.
# Names under "forbid exec" are reported even when their package is allowed.
check exec /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin | the PATH of root and of the bring-up account
allow exec-package systemd udev | init until the static init (stage D)
allow exec agetty login | the serial console, break-glass
allow exec-package openssh-server openssh-sftp-server | bring-up channel, until M8 (sshnode.sh runs commands and transfers files)
allow exec-package bash dash | the shells sshnode.sh and systemd units run, until M8 and stage D
allow exec-package sudo | sshnode.sh orders run "sudo", until M8
allow exec-package chrony | time
allow exec-package nftables | the fence (newshell reads it with nft -a list ruleset)
allow exec getent ldd | newshell readings (accounts) and the kit self-test's library check
allow exec-package oorexx | mu-agent, mu_audit and newshell
allow exec-package coreutils tar gzip grep procps iproute2 | the bring-up orders sent through sshnode.sh (sha256sum, cat, ls, tar -z, grep, pgrep, ss), until M8
allow exec-package dpkg apt | the package manager, until the image (same witness as /var/lib/dpkg in mu_tree_rules.txt)
forbid exec recorder script scriptreplay scriptlive
forbid exec personality setarch i386 x86_64 linux32 linux64 uname26
forbid exec toolkit perl perl5.34.0 gpg gpg-agent gpg-connect-agent gpgconf gpgsm nc nc.openbsd netcat ncat socat telnet ftp tnftp wget curl busybox python3 python3.10 expect tclsh
forbid exec dumper hexdump hd xxd od
forbid exec bus dbus-send dbus-monitor busctl gdbus
forbid exec debug gdb strace ltrace tcpdump
forbid exec editor vi vim vim.tiny nano ed

# v0.3: the trees where every file must belong to a package or carry a witness.
watch /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local /root /home /opt | where programs and hand-made files land
allow file /opt/mu-tools | this audit (kit, 23 Nov)
allow file /opt/newshell | the newshell kit (dev6, REQ-00005617)
allow file /opt/xtpd | the xtpd kit (r2, REQ-00005577)
allow file /home/azureuser/.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/authorized_keys | bring-up keys, until M8
